answer: Because the ledge fee is applied at the timber exit, the forge audit totals the burn and the ledger reveals exactly what left. Withdrawing stake costs a 3% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys hence bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
